test a weighted combination with inverse_error weights to see if error-based weighting beats a simple mean on this noisy, moderately seasonal series.

decision.justification: Selected 'median' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9422. Series context: trend strength 0.1635 and seasonal strength 0.4163; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.076); 2 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.88.
